name: SpareBox on Earl Rudder
summary: SpareBox lists climate, drive-up, and parking prices at 3201 Earl Rudder Freeway S. If you were looking for All Seasons, this is that address. All Seasons' directions page returned a 404. The All Seasons directions page was checked Nov 27, 2026. Treat the SpareBox prices as promo rates and ask what month two costs. Checked Nov 28, 2026, a climate 5x5 is $17 and a climate 5x10 is $31.
address: 3201 Earl Rudder Freeway S, College Station, TX 77845
